P2A-DEV-CD01:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
IF ((a >= b AND a <= c) OR (a <= b AND a >= c)) { DISPLAYNL(a). } ELSEIF ((b >= a AND b <= c) OR (b <= a AND b >= c)) { DISPLAYNL(b). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL(c). }
P2A-DEV-CD02:

NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
IF (a == 0 OR b == 0) { DISPLAYNL("ZERO"). } ELSEIF ((a > 0 AND b > 0) OR (a < 0 AND b < 0)) { DISPLAYNL("SAME"). } ELSE { DISPLAYNL("MIXED"). }
